EU act (celex): alarm when Cellar lists an amending act not in 'znane_zmiany'. Polish act (eli): alarm when ISAP lists an amending act dated after 'baseline' and not in 'znane_zmiany'. 'wzorce' link the act to skills (SKILL.md + references/*.md, case-insensitive). After reviewing the skills against a new amendment: add it to znane_zmiany or raise baseline, with a dated note in 'przeglady'. Initial state 2026-10-19: znane_zmiany and baseline match what Cellar/ISAP showed that day; the watch does not assess changes before baseline.
